The guarantee best guess is mixed and conditional because high technology does not determine ordinary household access. It is a player-configurable world model, not a claim that the entire Third Imperium has one labor-independent welfare constitution.

 Human planetary and commercial institutions receive moderate positive control weight, with strong ownership concentration possible inside the interval. Industrial robots are not automatically autonomous political rulers. The moderate nonworking scenario counts technical operation, commerce, administration, care and useful creation. Mining equipment and technological level do not translate into a population participation rate. The exact local rights are editorial assumptions within the chosen developed configuration. This zero variant preserves the recognizable automated core-world possibility without importing its conditions into lower-tech planets or treating a short discussion as a detailed canonical census.

after.description:
The later 1248 milieu describes some civilized areas accepting Viral beings as citizens, despite widespread hostility from other Viral entities. The discovery lead is narrowed to this supported coexistence model rather than inventing one named universal Virus state. The guarantee best guess assumes mixed conditional human access, with technological substitution an explicit low-confidence material interpretation. Recognizing artificial persons does not itself establish free necessities for all humans.

 Human and mixed civic agency receives positive control weight, with strong Viral operational power left inside a broad interval. Citizenship does not automatically mean either human ownership of the machines or machine sovereignty over residents. The modest human nonworking scenario counts services, administration, maintenance, care and useful creation. Viral persons’ contribution is disclosed separately, not converted into a robot ratio. The chosen polity flag and edition scope prevent later coexistence lore from becoming an automatic feature of every early New Era encounter or every hostile machine enclave.
